headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely interest payment certification on listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited has certified to NSE that it made timely payment of interest on its publicly-issued, listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation 57.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a financial services company, issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) through a public offering and listed them on NSE. The company has now certified to the exchange, pursuant to SEBI LODR Regulation 57, that all interest payments on these debentures have been made on schedule. This is a routine compliance notification required of all listed debt issuers to assure the market of timely servicing of obligations.
